When will this happen:
The new Windows Insider experience rollout began in April 2026 and has recently fully reached all Windows Insider channels. Retail versions of Windows now also see the new WIP channel options. 

How this will affect your organization:
The Windows Insider and Windows Insider Program documentation sites now have a redesigned web experience and updated content structure.

Organizational environments that rely on Windows Insider builds for testing, validation, or early feature evaluation might experience changes in where and how to access related documentation, announcements, and guidance. This includes updates related to new preview builds, feature introductions, and deprecations. Use this information to start testing the recently announced Windows 11, version 26H2 via the Windows Insider Program.
 
What you need to do to prepare:
Review internal processes for monitoring WIP updates. Ensure awareness of the new web experience and updated documentation content locations.

Update processes that depend on tracking feature lifecycle events to reflect the new blog-driven and documentation-based communication approach.

Additional information
  • See Our commitment to Windows quality for an overview of recent Windows Insider improvements and ongoing Microsoft quality initiatives.
